publisher: Co*Tive Collector local governed data hub
ownership: Derived linkage evidence whose export rights are bounded by every contributing source policy
review_status: Local review layer; no derived linkage is approved for public export until benchmarked precision and all contributing source policies are evaluated.
allowed_use: local exact-match aliasing under versioned deterministic rules
reversible downstream grouping without overwriting source entities
prohibited_use: silently overwriting source identities or assertions
inferring an establishment match from co-location alone
inferring ownership, parent company, or general operating status
exporting linkage rows before source-policy and precision review
attribution: Derived from the governed National Business Registry; retain every contributing source reference and ruleset version.
retention: Retain immutable decision releases locally with dependency hashes and reversible status; review decisions may supersede but never erase prior evidence.
redistribution: Local review only until a separately approved export policy confirms benchmark precision and the most restrictive contributing source rights.
personal_data_note: May include linkage evidence involving source-reported home-based principal offices; do not expose record-level decisions without review.
